scope: Actual standalone runtime public API with independently authored machine-code fixtures; no module injection, browser, audio-device or hardware acceptance.

results.name: Unloaded runtime cannot silently pretend to have a tracing source
Loaded source identity is its actual immutable file, including trainer bytes
Observation is opt-in and coverage names original instruction PCs and physical offsets
Snapshot A/B reads backing memory without changing PPU, controller or APU read latches
Snapshot outputs cannot alter retained comparison data
RAM comparisons distinguish unsigned increase, decrease, equal value and unchanged
RAM comparison result pagination neither skips nor duplicates matches
Comparison filters and paging reject malformed requests rather than silently widening a search
RAM watches canonicalize mirrored writes and report the actual STA instruction
Eight watch bound and permitted memory regions are enforced without duplicates
PPU and APU events retain execution origin without inventing origins for external bus writes
Observed-resource copies preserve unknown bytes and cannot mutate evidence
Trace event cap stops recording with bounded evidence while emulation continues
Reset invalidates snapshots and observations but preserves watches within the same ROM
Replacement ROM clears old identity, observations, snapshots and watch meaning
A failed unsupported emulator load leaves the existing analysis source intact
Exported observation report is a copied record and cannot be imported as a project
Pending identity and trace start cannot survive reset of their original runtime session
Pending identity and trace start cannot survive replacement of their original runtime session
Pending identity and trace start cannot survive clear of their original runtime session
Executed RAM code is observed without inventing a physical ROM source
A failing presentation subscriber cannot change instruction execution or trace collection
Coverage-entry bound stops before collecting an unbounded NOP region
Explicit Stop cancels a pending hash and cannot arm tracing after the user stopped it
